name: Mod Profiler
description: A sampling profiler that shows how much of each frame every installed mod takes

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

overlay-key.name: Show the table
overlay-key.description: Shows and hides the table of mods in the game: each mod's own time a frame, its share, and for the mod you click, the hooks and functions it spends it in

table-corner.name: Table corner
table-corner.description: Where the table is on the screen

export-key.name: Save a profile
export-key.description: Saves the last 10 seconds of samples to a file in the mod's save folder (the log says where). Open it at <cy>speedscope.app</c> for a flame graph of every stack

enabled.name: Sampling
enabled.description: Looks at the game's main thread about once a millisecond to see which mod's code it is in. Off: the profiler does nothing

interval.name: Sample every (ms)
interval.description: Less is more precise and costs more. Every sample stops the main thread for some microseconds

spike-threshold.name: Slow frame (ms)
spike-threshold.description: A frame longer than this is looked into: whose time it was, in which function, with a few stacks. In the table and in the log

log-spikes.name: Slow frames in the log
log-spikes.description: A line for every slow frame, with its culprit and one of its stacks

symbols.name: Function names
symbols.description: Names the functions in the table from the mods' PDB files (a mod built on this computer has one where it was built) and from export tables. Off: module+offset

logger-watch.name: Pinned in Improved Logger
logger-watch.description: With <cy>Improved Logger</c>: the fps, the mods with the most own time, the slow frames and the profiler's cost pinned in its console. Its marker key (<cy>Ctrl+Shift+M</c>) also logs the profile since the last marker

log-diagnostics.name: Diagnostics in the log
log-diagnostics.description: Once a second, a line in the log: how many samples, how long the main thread was stopped for each, and the mods taking the most time

log-stacks.name: Stacks in the log
log-stacks.description: A few sampled stacks a second in the log, as module+offset. For checking the profiler itself
